rationale: Asmita's deep expertise in LLM post-training and multimodal AI aligns directly with Simone's conviction that AI integration requires technical depth—and her marketing leadership at infrastructure companies like vCluster and VMware Tanzu positions her to help articulate how advanced AI workloads reshape cloud-native systems. Asmita's research on responsible AI and model optimization, combined with Simone's experience scaling marketing for complex technical infrastructure, creates a natural collaboration opportunity around positioning next-generation AI infrastructure to technical audiences.
intro_message: Asmita Hajra, meet Simone Morellato — she leads marketing for AI-native infrastructure and would benefit from your research perspective on LLM post-training and responsible AI, while her experience scaling products in kubernetes and cloud-native could inform how your research gets adopted in production systems.
